name: Sparse Voxel Octree Construction
definition: An extension of the simple voxelization that builds and updates a sparse voxel octree directly, avoiding an intermediate full regular grid. It scales to large scenes by constructing the octree structure directly on the GPU.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree Construction builds octrees directly from meshes on the GPU using OpenGL 4.0+ draw indirect and atomic counters, avoiding full grids for real-time scalability.
